hooks.command: if command -v daedalus >/dev/null 2>&1; then daedalus hook stop; fi

command -v daedalus >/dev/null 2>&1 || ( python -m pip install -q -e . ) >/dev/null 2>&1; if command -v daedalus >/dev/null 2>&1; then daedalus hook session-start; else echo '{"systemMessage": "This repository is gated by Daedalus, which is not installed here: pip install \"git+https://github.com/KEV-INZHU/Daedalus\""}'; fi
if command -v daedalus >/dev/null 2>&1; then daedalus hook prompt; fi
if command -v daedalus >/dev/null 2>&1; then daedalus hook pre-edit; fi

statusLine.command: if command -v daedalus >/dev/null 2>&1; then daedalus statusline; fi
